# **June Temperature Trends**

```{r}
#| label: June_Trends
#| include: true
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# filter for June temperatures
june_data <- subset(temp_data, month == "Jun")
# fit a GLM model to see if there is a trend in July temperatures over time, separated by sit
june_model <- glm(temp_C ~ year*site_no, data = june_data)
summary(june_model)




ggplot()


```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
